# TankmanPro

> TankmanPro is an on-demand mechanized water tank cleaning and professional home maintenance platform in India with upfront city-wise pricing, certified technicians, and automated dispatch across verified 6-digit PIN codes.

TankmanPro operates across Delhi NCR, Shahjahanpur, and Kanpur. We deliver 4-stage scientific water tank cleaning (sludge dewatering, high-pressure rotary scrubbing, vacuum extraction, and UV antibacterial treatment), certified electrician repairs (53 variants), licensed plumbing (18 variants), interior/exterior painting, carpentry, AC service and repair, and sofa/carpet sanitization.
